installers.description: Opt-in portable Lanes CLI and native global Codex/Claude skill copies; no hooks, settings or credentials.
Copy the lanes skill into a target repository and record the source revision in .agents/sklanes-install.json.

optional.name: node
optional.description: Node.js >=22 runs the lanes command and its installer. The installer checks the version itself.

optional.name: git
optional.description: Records the source revision of an install.

npx.install: npx skills add rahuldave/sklanes -g -a codex -a claude-code --skill lanes --copy -y
